hero_cards.name: Odysseus
hero_cards.power: Return one played attack card to your hand.

hero_cards.name: Achilles
hero_cards.power: Add one attack card regardless of rank (play with card).

hero_cards.name: Hermes
hero_cards.power: Disable the crown suit for one round.

hero_cards.name: Ajax
hero_cards.power: Auto-defend one attack; attacker discards one random card.

hero_cards.name: Hades
hero_cards.power: Defender may use only crown cards (standalone).

hero_cards.name: Medea
hero_cards.power: Exchange one card with defender's highest or crown card (start of round).

hero_cards.name: Ares
hero_cards.power: Inflict one wound even if fully defended (end of round, play with card).

hero_cards.name: Autolycus
hero_cards.power: The player who played Autolycus may redefine the crown suit for one round.

hero_cards.name: Circe
hero_cards.power: Name a dominion; defender cannot play that dominion this round.
